requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest, and the agency that made the arrest
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest, and the agency that made the arrest
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the arrest and the name of the agency that made it, taken from the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Charge of which the requester was convicted, and the Code section it was under, worded exactly as the court record words them
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Charge of which the requester was convicted, and the Code section it was under, worded exactly as the court record words them
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no charge fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the charge of which you were convicted and its Code section, worded exactly as the court record words them

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the conviction, as it appears on the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the conviction, as it appears on the court record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the conviction, copied from the court record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The Virginia county or city where the conviction was had, in the address line to the clerk
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The Virginia county or city where the conviction was had, in the address line to the clerk
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the locality of conviction lives on a record the platform has not seen, and caption styling is the clerk's own practice
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Virginia county or city where the conviction was had - that circuit court's clerk can confirm it, and can tell you how that court styles a caption

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the case ended, and on what date
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the case ended, and on what date
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the case ended and on what date, from the case file, checked against your own CCRE record - correct the request if they disagree

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Full name used at the time of arrest, exactly as the court record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Full name used at the time of arrest, exactly as the court record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the record's exact wording is on the record, not in the platform
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the full name you used at the time of arrest, copied exactly from the court record - the clerk of the circuit court of the locality of conviction holds the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.why: no offence fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the offence, taken from the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the Governor granted the absolute pardon, as the pardon document states it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the Governor granted the absolute pardon, as the pardon document states it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the pardon is a record the platform has not seen, and whether it is absolute and recites innocence is what the subsection turns on
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the Governor granted the pardon, copied from the pardon document itself - the Office of the Secretary of the Commonwealth issues the certified copy

protectedBlanks.label: Signature on the transmittal and request
protectedBlanks.why: the requester signs the transmittal personally

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the transmittal and request
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the request is signed would be false
